title: How to Search, Scrape, and Crawl the Web from a Convex App with Firecrawl
summary: Build a documentation search app on Convex using Firecrawl search, crawl, and scrape. The official Firecrawl Convex component runs inside your deployment and writes crawled pages into your database as they're found, so your React UI subscribes to a crawl instead of polling for it.
